Theme

Playground equipment, sandbox toys, vehicles and play · Travel & transport

tunnel noun

also underground passage

classical

cunīculus, cunīculī m.

noun, second declension

tunnel, underground passage

An ancient noun applied to sand play.

Other words

  • specus, specūs m. — tunnel; cave

    noun, fourth declension · classical · Traupman 219, 203, 399

    Traupman prints only specus.

Examples

  • ventus ē specū ērūpit, lūmina appāruērunt

    a wind burst out of the tunnel, lights appearedcomposed

See also hole, sandcastle, metro, deer.
